_howToUpdate: Who appears on the leaderboard comes from data/players.json — add, rename or remove people there and both tables follow.
Scores go under the round id: "r4": 86. Leave null until played; totals add up automatically and unplayed rounds show as a dash.
A player with no entry in `players` below still gets a row of dashes, so filling this in is optional.
Counters are plain numbers. Whoever leads a column gets a badge; zeroes never do.
Keys in `players` are matched to names in players.json, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. Rename someone there and the old key here stops matching — the console says which ones didn't match.
